review: Independent visual hypothesis after E06; no product files changed
baseline: E05 (restore E06 text changes before test)

evidence.cta_sources: All100 CTA sessions use hero_cta; this does not establish genuine early action or show tariff-button use.
css_facts: Form fields are white inside white registration panel with1px #d8d2cb borders.
Normal submit and tariff buttons use pastel #b8d4e3; hero uses dark #194f68.
Normal button text has strong contrast despite low surface contrast; do not call this a text-legibility failure.
Actual buttons still have cursor:pointer and hover motion; noninteractive card affordances were removed in E05.
Expanded tariff has blue border and1.02scale; no observed tariff-button selection separates outcomes.

main_hypothesis.claim: Increasing the contrast of existing input boundaries may make where to begin more immediately apparent and increase first-input starts among form viewers.
main_hypothesis.confidence: low; verified visual property, unproven behavioral mechanism
main_hypothesis.why_this_factor: The observed loss is before any input; completion after input is25/25, so submit contrast is less directly tied to the measured loss than entry-field salience.
main_hypothesis.single_factor: Only default input/textarea border color, no geometry, text, focus policy, button color or form-required changes.
exact_diff_plan: Restore index.php form copy from E05, because E06 copy is the confounding factor.
Change .form-grid input,.form-grid textarea border-color from #d8d2cb to #64748b; keep1px width and all dimensions.
Retain all four required fields, form/action, API, pricing and course content.
main_hypothesis.prediction: Input-start/CTA increases above E05 while CTA exposure and input-start-to-conversion remain similar.
main_hypothesis.falsifier: With correct variant exposure, field boundary color changes but input-start fraction and confirmed conversion do not improve in comparable batches.
main_hypothesis.primary_metric: Confirmed simulator orders/100 visits. Never count focus or mere visibility as a conversion.
diagnostics: registration_input_start unique sessions / registration_view unique sessions
risks: Darker field outlines can make a four-field form look heavier rather than easier.
All75 CTA-abandonments are inert after CTA; scripted start/stop behavior could dominate and not depend on this visual change.
Sequential batches and100 visits cannot isolate small effects or prove underlying50% conversion.

rejected_for_immediate_test.reason: All25 starters already complete, so it does not directly target the observed loss. Could still influence willingness to begin, but evidence is weaker.
No divergent tariff interactions and all recorded CTA sources are hero. Price sensitivity is not established; changing multiple commercial variables would obscure interpretation.

rejected_for_immediate_test.factor: Global recolor of all buttons and inputs
rejected_for_immediate_test.reason: Too broad; cannot distinguish input salience from CTA or overall styling.

test_protocol: Deploy E05 baseline plus only chosen border-color change and variant.
Run isolated100 visits; capture simulator outcome and check exposure/session IDs.
Inspect full rrweb for successful and nonstarting sessions; compare with E05; avoid interpreting clamped negative clicks as human frustration.
Do not infer mobile conversion from desktop-only simulator.
